exact: transcription of nuclear large rRNA transcript from RNA polymerase I promoter
transcription of nuclear rRNA large Pol I transcript
transcription of nucleolar large rRNA by RNA polymerase I

definition: The synthesis of the large ribosomal RNA (rRNA) transcript which encodes several rRNAs, e.g. in mammals 28S, 18S and 5.8S, from a nuclear DNA template transcribed by RNA polymerase I.
label: nucleolar large rRNA transcription by RNA polymerase I
